messages:
jordan: spotted negative cache savings on the cost dashboard for some tenants after the canary :confused:
kai: saw that. t-893 and t-441. looks like prefetch credits duplicated by backfill
maria: can you grab a minimal repro (tenant, window, batch id)?
jordan: t-893, 2026-03-17, backfill-20260317
alex: backfill emits credits tagged "prefetch:backfill". rollup groups by credit_type and sums, so backfill+live counted twice
paul: quick fix idea: dedupe credits by (origin_id, request_signature) within 24h
nori: careful, some flows legitimately get multiple credits. need precedence rules (backfill < prefetch < rebate)
maria: dashboard changes: (1) fix rollup dedupe; (2) show an explain row for negative-net tenants with top contributing credits
ops-bot: billing-rollup job failed on canary-3 2h ago: https://ci.internal/reports/6821
alex: i'll patch rollup to dedupe and add debug flag to dump raw credit events
jordan: UX: sparkline hover shows token-burn, cache-savings, backfill-credits, model-sku cost. add counterfactual toggle to hide prefetch credits
kai: backend API sketch: GET /internal/v1/cost-preview?tenant=t-893&window=24h&counterfactual=prefetch -> numeric fields + provenance array
maria: provenance limited to top 10 + "others" bucket to keep payload small
paul: sampling note: some tenants are 10% sampled. extrapolate credits carefully for counterfactuals
alex: PoC branch /internal/cost-preview v0.2 with provenance + counterfactual, will add tests and feature flag
jordan: canary plan: canary-2 w/ debug for 2h, validate t-893/t-441/t-1023, then roll fix to canary-3
maria: support blurb draft: "duplicate prefetch credits from a backfill affected displayed cache-saving numbers. fix deployed; billing unaffected."
paul: PR #8245 opened to fix rollup; marking urgent
ops-bot: PR #8245 merged into canary-2 by alex (ci: green)
kai: running debug canary, will report in ~20m
alex: post-fix t-893 shows cache_savings 0 -> 420, negatives gone
maria: ready to roll out tomorrow if canary stays green
jordan: thanks everyone, post screenshots here when you have them :thumbsup:
